records.title: HeteroM-ILT: hybrid CNN and state space model for high-fidelity mask optimization
records.reason: HeteroM-ILT uses a hybrid CNN/Mamba-style model to optimize semiconductor lithography masks; it discusses faster inference for the lithography task, not language-model inference or serving.

records.title: An overview of transformers for video anomaly detection
records.reason: Springer publisher full text was unavailable in this session. The title/abstract describe a survey of vision-transformer video-anomaly detection, and the linked Q-BERT family makes quantization adjacency plausible, but no primary-body methods/evaluation could be checked.

records.title: Large-scale simulation study of active learning models for systematic reviews
records.reason: The open-access Springer article evaluates active-learning classifier and feature-extractor combinations over more than 29,000 systematic-review screening simulations. It finds no universally best model and studies screening efficiency; it does not optimize LLM inference, compression, or serving. The MiniLMv2 linkage is contextual to screening models rather than a compression contribution.

records.title: BadMoE: Backdooring Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Optimizing Routing Triggers and Infecting Dormant Experts
records.reason: BadMoE studies backdoor attacks on MoE LLMs by routing-trigger optimization and dormant-expert infection. It is a security/vulnerability study, not an inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Log Sequence Anomaly Detection Based on Template and Parameter Parsing via BERT
records.reason: IEEE publisher page did not provide the paper body. The abstract describes BERT-based log anomaly detection and parsing for an application task; linked MiniLM compression is only indirect and cannot be checked against full text.
